title: Understanding the Loss Function
text: The loss function is defined as the difference between the observed value $$y_i$$ and the predicted value $$\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x_i\right)$$. Think about how this difference can guide the adjustment of theta values.

title: Gradient Descent Basics
text: In gradient descent, we update the parameters by moving in the direction that reduces the loss. This involves calculating the derivative of the loss with respect to each parameter.

title: Partial Derivative with Respect to $$\Theta_0$$
text: To find the partial derivative of the loss with respect to $$\theta_0$$, consider how the term $$0.5\theta_0$$ affects the loss function. What happens when you differentiate this term?

title: Calculate the Partial Derivative
text: What is the partial derivative of the loss function L(theta) with respect to $$\theta_0$$?

title: Partial Derivative with Respect to $$\Theta_1$$
text: For $$\theta_1$$, consider the terms $$\theta_0 \theta_1 x_1$$ and $$sin\left(\theta_1\right) x_2$$ in the model. How do these terms contribute to the loss when differentiated with respect to $$\theta_1$$?

title: Calculate the Partial Derivative for $$\Theta_1$$
text: What is the partial derivative of the loss function L(theta) with respect to $$\theta_1$$?

title: Update Rule for $$\Theta_0$$
text: The update rule for $$\theta_0$$ involves subtracting the product of the learning rate and the partial derivative of the loss with respect to $$\theta_0$$ from the current value of $$\theta_0$$.

title: First Update for $$\Theta_0$$
text: If the learning rate is $$0.1$$, what is the updated value of $$\theta_0$$ after one iteration?

title: Update Rule for $$\Theta_1$$
text: The update rule for $$\theta_1$$ is similar to that for $$\theta_0$$. Consider how the learning rate and the partial derivative with respect to $$\theta_1$$ affect the update.
